input: How many products are in the Toys category?

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Toys'

input: What was the total revenue in April 2026?

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'

input: What are the names of the 3 products with the highest list price, most expensive first?

expected.label: clear
expected.note: Ranking by a stored column, order explicit.

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY list_price DESC, name LIMIT 3

input: How many orders are there for each status? Return the status and the count.

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

input: How many customers from India placed at least one order, of any status, in 2026?

expected.label: clear
expected.note: Country, status scope and year are explicit.

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'India' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'

input: Who is our top customer in Australia?

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.country = 'Australia' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

interpretations.clarifying_answer: By the number of orders, counting all statuses.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Australia' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

input: How many customers signed up recently?

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-02' AND '2026-06-30'

input: How many loyal customers do we have?

expected.label: ambiguous
expected.note: Three or more orders, or ordered in both 2025 and 2026.

interpretations.description: customers with 3+ orders of any status
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3)

interpretations.description: customers with orders in both 2025 and 2026
interpretations.clarifying_answer: Customers who ordered in both 2025 and 2026.
interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31') > 0 AND SUM(order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31') > 0)

input: What were our total payments in May 2026?

interpretations.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE amount > 0 AND payment_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31'
